card.name: Inside long words in all capitals
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long ALL-CAPS words or abbreviations, such as LEG in Latin inscriptions or IMM-UN-ODEFICIENCY. The word is not yet finished.

modes.label: Latin inscriptions
modes.description: Capitalised abbreviations like LEG or VEXILL in Roman inscriptions.
modes.example: |CONCORDIAE<< LEG>> VI VI P F ET LEG XX|

modes.label: Spaced or capitalised medical headings
modes.description: Middle pieces of capitalised medical terms and section headings.

modes.label: Capitalised book headings
modes.description: Middle pieces of capitalised Latin or Greek headings.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue the capitalised word with a letter-like ending piece such as m, y or la.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long capitalised word, when the rest of the word is still to come.
